Hi everyone.

My name is Abhishek Shivakumar. I'm a software developer and independent researcher based in Cambridge, UK, and I work mostly around DSP, real-time systems, and mathematical modelling.

I’m using Lean/mathlib for an external formalization project around perturbation robustness in dynamical systems. The areas I expect to touch are mostly analysis / topology / linear algebra / operator theory / measure-theoretic probability / semigroups, but I’m still gradually learning the existing mathlib layout. I’d be grateful for pointers on where to ask questions about formalizing this kind of material, and on what kinds of small contributions would be most useful.

It's pretty exciting to see how much enthusiasm the community has, and how far this piece of tech has come. I'm looking forward to working with all of you!
Hello! This channel is perfectly fine for questions, as is #Is there code for X?. For concrete contributions, you can ask in #mathlib4
